lines.1: Man, the air of freedom sure tastes good.
lines.2: 「Good thing the Principal trained you himself over the weekend.」
lines.3: That was the story as far as everyone else knew.
lines.4: 「You've got a tan, too. You seem a little tougher now.」
lines.7: 「And for that, you need the source of all energy: rice balls!」
lines.8: I ate the rice ball Otome had made.
lines.10: 「I'll be going back to my family home now and then over summer vacation, but don't get lonely, all right?」
lines.12: Otome was in high spirits because I'd gotten a little tougher (though I had a feeling all I'd done was get a tan).
